title: api() caches only success; a missing or incompatible quillvideo library is re-searched and re-dlopen'd for every video sticker
trigger: Run a build where the quillvideo library exists but lacks the qs_* symbols (or fails to load), then scroll a chat with many video stickers
effect: Every decode_in_process call repeats candidates() is_file probes and library loads before falling back to ffmpeg; wasted work per sticker, no wrong result
fix: Cache the Result in a OnceLock<Result<&'static Api, String>> (a Loaded/Unavailable enum) so a failed lookup is remembered

title: OlderEnd::Asking(RequestId) is unused for forum topic pages; topic in-flight is found by purpose+topic scan of the request table
trigger: Forum topic older page: apply_topic_page/fail_topic_page never call ask_older/settle_older; topic_page_in_flight re-derives 'asking' from requests.ids_for_chat(purposes) filtered by forum_topic_id
effect: No bug today (drop_topic_pages_past forgets stale requests so late answers find no pending), but the stage lives in two places and fail_older() accepts any failure regardless of id
fix: Call ask_older(id) when the topic page is sent and settle_older(id) in apply_topic_page/fail_topic_page, like saved-messages and thread histories, and drop the purpose scan

title: StoryPageOps::begin at the 64-op cap evicts the oldest op even when none is finished, dropping an in-flight op
trigger: 64 story-page ops in flight at once (position() finds no finished op and falls back to index 0)
effect: The evicted request's answer finds no op, so its Checking/Sending status never settles into Succeeded/Failed and its toast is lost
fix: Refuse or queue the new op, or only evict finished ops

title: WebApps holds ten one-shot answer slots (open_result, write_access, emoji_access, data_sent, phone_share, custom_replies, found, attachment_menu_bot, attachment_menu_toggled) that forget_web_app_launches only partly clears
trigger: Leave an account while a mini-app send-data, write-access or emoji-access call is out; the answer lands after forget_web_app_launches
effect: The answer waits in the session until the account is live and the poll takes it; no window matches its RequestId so it is dropped. Bounded by the per-tick drain, so no visible bug
fix: One per-owner answer queue keyed by RequestId, cleared in a single forget method, or answers delivered straight to the window stage that holds the RequestId
